description: This file defines the FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategy class, which implements entitlement consumption logic using a FIFO approach for leave management in an HR system. It manages the use and cancellation of leave entitlements, handles leave period changes, and retrieves leave entitlement limits. The class interacts with DAOs and other services to modify entitlement data based on leave activities, following the FIFO (First-In, First-Out) strategy.

classes.name: FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategy
classes.description: Implements entitlement consumption using FIFO logic for leave management, including handling leave creation, cancellation, period changes, and retrieving leave entitlement limits.

methods.name: getDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the DAO object for entitlement consumption strategy.

methods.name: handleLeaveCreate
methods.description: Processes a leave creation request, allocating entitlement days using FIFO order, and returns the current and changed entitlement details.

methods.name: handleEntitlementStatusChange
methods.description: Placeholder for handling entitlement status changes; currently not implemented.

methods.name: handleLeaveCancel
methods.description: Handles the cancellation of a leave, reverting entitlement usage accordingly and returning the affected entitlement changes.

methods.name: handleLeavePeriodChange
methods.description: Propagates changes to leave period start month and day to the DAO for updates.

methods.name: getLeaveWithoutEntitlementDateLimitsForLeaveBalance
methods.description: Calculates date limits for leave balance calculations where no entitlements are assigned.

methods.name: getLeavePeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the current leave period for a given date.
